name: DS Cluster D17: Carry Proxy Trap
description: Tests: futures_continuation cont.carry output vs returns-based proxy. Validates cont.carry and cont.dte exist on futures pass-through.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER D17: Carry Proxy Trap
# =============================================================================
# Rule: Use cont.carry for term structure, NOT returns-based annualization.
# On non-futures assets, cont.carry is NaN — guard with is_valid().

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# === CONTINUATION (pass-through on stocks) ===
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

# === CARRY: guard with is_valid (NaN on non-futures) ===
has_carry = is_valid(cont.carry) and is_valid(cont.dte) and (cont.dte > 0)

# CORRECT: use cont.carry directly
raw_carry = where(has_carry, cont.carry)

# CORRECT: annualize only when DTE is available
annualized_carry = where(has_carry, cont.carry * (365.0 / cont.dte))

# WRONG (on futures): returns-based proxy loses term structure info
# returns_proxy = (close - (close >> 1)) / (close >> 1) * 365
# This measures PRICE returns, not CARRY.

# === REPORTERS ===
cards(
    category="Carry",
    layout=CardLayout(title="Carry Availability", cells=[
        ColumnSpec(title="Has Carry", card_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat)
    ])
)(has_carry)

histogram(
    title="Raw Carry (NaN on stocks — expected)",
    category="Carry",
    bins=20
)(raw_carry)
